name: Search Atlas
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Search Atlas is TAG's main SEO platform: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, LLM visibility, GSC mirroring and **OTTO** (with the **MetaSync** WordPress plugin), which injects titles, metas, H1 overrides, schema, alts and internal links on client sites. Scott's decision: Search Atlas diagnoses, Claude fixes. The shared `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Search Atlas\` folder is now empty except its `.claude` config; client exports moved into each client's `search-atlas\` folder.

# Access
- Search Atlas MCP connector: **failing since Sep 29, 2026** (credential error). Fallback is dashboard.searchatlas.com in Kim-Main Chrome, read-only.
- Keyword lookup quota was used up around Sep 26 to 30; reuse saved projects and existing keyword pools.
- RAPID URL Indexer: 1 free batch credit, then about $0.10 per URL.
- Cost noted in handoffs: about $100 per month per site; 1,500 extra credits bought for $57. Backlinks: about $50 per month per client through Search Atlas.

# Project references
| Client | Rank tracker project |
|---|---|
| Summit AZ | 84536 |
| Pipeliners | 34164 |
| Alphalete | 82050 |
Alphalete's OTTO project is `5c619c90-4086-48ad-afb7-943f3b912546`. The [Client Report Dashboard](lib:brain-client-report-dashboard) also uses Search Atlas map grids per client.

# How each site uses it
- **Pipeliners and Alphalete:** MetaSync/OTTO is the only live SEO head (titles, meta, H1 overrides, canonical, schema, sitemap). Rank Math and Yoast are off and must not be reactivated; `rank_math_*` meta is inert. On Alphalete, `_metasync_seo_desc` post meta beats an OTTO-locked meta description.
- **Summit AZ:** moved to Rank Math in Sep 2026.

# OTTO operating rules (from client guides)
- OTTO edits only for items Kim approved; OTTO is Kim's responsibility.
- Edit the suggestion by `url_id`, then deploy scoped by `url_ids` (never all at once). If a field will not refresh, undeploy and redeploy.
- OTTO crawl frequency is "Never": new URLs get no OTTO record until a recrawl is triggered, and OTTO does not discover new posts (Pipeliners uses a mu-plugin for new post metas).
- Turning on the OTTO pixel or MetaSync deploys every queued fix at once, including unsafe ones.
- Pipeliners: never run a full cache flush; a Sep 17 outage wiped OTTO data on 34 of 37 city pages. OTTO data caches 24h; refresh one URL at a time.
- In OTTO internal-link rows, the row URL is the destination. Never put `@graph` in an OTTO schema slot.
- Never contact or draft to Search Atlas support.

# Data caveats
- Search Atlas GSC data is directional only; the GSC UI is the source of truth. Always filter US-only (Philippines traffic is internal testing).
- The `gsc_*` tools read URL-prefix properties and drop anonymized queries; do not use them for per-page work.
